structure_features: target-local ECDF rank of negative primary_pose_vina_affinity
target-local pose-score spread and pose count
candidate_score_definition.increment: r(d,t) fitted only against cross-fitted residuals after the base is frozen
candidate_score_definition.eligibility: a(t) from label-independent receptor/pocket QC only
candidate_score_definition.exact_fallback_invariant: if qualified structure evidence is absent then a(t)=0 and s(d,t)=b(d,t) exactly

stage0_test.purpose: test whether label-blind target-local docking ranks contain any incremental signal before training EQIR
stage0_test.fit: choose one nonnegative scalar increment weight on each validation role only
stage0_test.evaluate: apply once to the matching held-out test role
stage0_test.stop_if: pooled S3 development gain is nonpositive or either target-homology or scaffold grouped bootstrap CI includes zero
stage0_test.not_novel: the scalar screen is a feasibility test and is not the proposed algorithm

prohibited_inputs: Gate A/B qualification derived from labels in the evaluation fold
raw GNINA scores compared across targets
missing or gate-failed structure encoded as a negative interaction
